sn45.23:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Tatravoca || || Micchāpaṭipadañca vo bhikkhave desissāmi sammāpaṭipadañca || taṃ suṇātha || || Katamā ca bhikkhave micchāpaṭipadā || || Seyyathīdaṃ || micchādiṭṭhi || pa [pe] || micchāsamādhi || || Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave micchāpaṭipadā || || Katamā ca bhikkhave sammāpaṭipadā || || Seyyathīdam || sammādiṭṭhi || pa [pe] || sammāsamādhi || || Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sammāpaṭipadā ti || || 1.2.
